anchor.problem: Repeated exhaustive timing evaluation of mutually exclusive fixed-topology cell-replacement worlds from one immutable base.
anchor.downstream_need: Lower total time for identical full candidate timing/electrical outputs and reference selection, with complete charged reporting/restoration.
anchor.causal_mechanism: Maintain operation-specific exact world partitions by dependency-class intersection, split and result re-coalescence; test administrative and bounded-memory dispatch cost beyond same-key memoization.
mechanism_invariants: Every requested world/candidate and complete output remains available; no mask/selected-subset output contract.
Complete exact operation context; hashes are indexes and full keys checked; upstream load and all phase dependencies included.
Prediction/algorithmic agents schedule or admit work only; no learned equality/correctness certificate.
Same-key memo parity and output materialization cost are mandatory negative controls.
Single base/epoch; unsupported impure/cyclic engine work uses isolated charged reference fallback.
No predecessor covariance, signatures, acceptance, exposure erasure or automatic resource transfer.
forbidden_pivots: Claiming generic caching, transaction undo, task grouping or agent count as the research contribution.
Dropping full endpoint/candidate outputs, filtering low-n/no-reuse cases, or optimizing a cache-hit proxy without decision-time demand.
Escaping same-key memoization by giving the proposal extra features, future traces, memory or hidden reference work.
Changing to selective residual-covariance acquisition or MCMM/wider ECO scope merely to manufacture headroom.

combination_drift.rationale: Initial new anchor explicitly concedes known components and memo parity; no prior topic acceptance or mechanism is renamed.

demand_drift.rationale: Same domain need for reference-consistent timing decisions; no claimed demonstrated demand. Initial exhaustive contract is explicit.

changes: New successor mechanism; retained predecessor negatives.
Own memo-parity reduction narrows potential contribution to administration/memory cost.
revision_assessment.reason: Initial EDA-0010 anchor; zero is not a merit/readiness score.

resurrection_conditions: Any post-batch research requires new finite authorization.
Resolve specific administration distinction, representative exact-key economics, engine dependency/restore locks and actual resources.
Fresh exact-target P/C consents and independent readiness verification; no inherited approval.
